notes: The six things left open after tonight's driving, all closed. Your clips play and the TV angles finally appear: the player asks for the multi-angle file whenever one exists and the server only ever accepted a clip's own path, so every clip whose angles had been filmed answered 'not found', the card stayed grey, and the angle footage on your disk was never shown - 11 of your 52 clips. They play smoothly too: the files were never broken, just enormous (OBS records 1440p at ~120 Mbit/s, so a 28-second clip is 423 MB), and the player now gets a 720p copy while the original stays untouched for export. Every overlay remembers its place PER GAME - telemetry, radar, tyres, chassis, pit box, Corners, Stint and the SMART panel - inheriting whatever you already had. You can choose which moments go in a highlights video BEFORE you make it, so one race gives you a crashes video and an overtakes video without either overwriting the other. A new option closes the sim when the filming finishes, so you can walk away. The radar stops flickering: it cleared its canvas before redrawing, thirty times a second. And SMART can read your Assetto Corsa setup - it demanded the setup's track match the circuit, while 23 of your 60 AC setups live in the car's generic folder, which applies anywhere.
